title: Nullity of the upper right quadrant boundary
statement: Let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$ and $t\in\mathbb R$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the probability distribution obtained from independent standard Gaussian variables $U,V$ by setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$. The boundary of the set $\{(x,y):t<x\text{ and }t<y\}$ has probability zero under this distribution.
